en.title: Moj Kolega
en.subtitle: An AI employee for your webshop. It answers customers, recommends from your catalogue, captures the leads you'd lose after hours, and hands off to your team when it should - 24/7. We set it up, watch it, and improve it every month. You see results, not another chatbot.

An overnight report - questions answered, recommended and escalated through the night, resolved alone vs handed to the team
The five jobs Moj Kolega does - grounded answers, recommendations, lead capture and five languages, all from the shop's own data

sections.title: Hire a Role, Not a Chatbot
sections.lede: Most shops bolt on a chatbot, watch it guess wrong, and switch it off. Moj Kolega is the opposite: a managed AI employee that answers only from your catalogue and policies, says "I don't know" instead of inventing, and gets better every month because someone is actually watching it.

items.title: Grounded, Never Invented
items.body:
Answers only from your catalogue and policies
When the data isn't there, it says so and escalates - it doesn't guess
Product picks come with a reason to buy, from your catalogue only
Every answer is traceable to the source it came from

items.title: Managed, Not DIY
items.body:
You don't get a prompt editor and a model picker. You hire a role - Sales, Support or Reception - and we do the rest: set it up, connect your catalogue, and test it against real questions before it goes live.

Then every month we send a report of what your customers asked, what the agent handled alone, what it missed, and what we changed. The improvement is the product, not a dashboard you have to babysit.

sections.title: Five Jobs, Done Reliably
sections.lede: Not forty jobs done badly by a generic model. Five that matter for a webshop, each grounded in your own data.

items.title: Answers, Grounded
items.body: From your catalogue and policies. When it doesn't know, it says so and hands off - it never guesses and costs you a sale.

items.title: Recommends the Right Product
items.body: Two or three picks for the need and the budget, each with a reason to buy - drawn from your catalogue, never invented.

items.title: Captures Leads You'd Lose
items.body: Wholesale, B2B and undecided buyers - qualified, with the full conversation, on your desk by morning instead of gone by dawn.

items.title: Escalates Safely
items.body: When it's out of its depth, it hands off to your team with the full context - a clean handoff, not a bluff.

items.title: Speaks Your Customers' Language
items.body: Detects the visitor's language on every message and replies in it - Croatian, English, Slovenian, Serbian and German.

items.title: Works the Night Shift
items.body: The hours your team is offline are when leads slip away. Moj Kolega covers them - and hands you the night's conversations in the morning.

sections.title: One Script, Grounded in Your Shop
sections.lede: Moj Kolega drops onto any site as a single widget - but the work behind it is what makes it trustworthy.

items.title: An Embeddable Widget
items.body:
One script tag on any site. It streams answers token by token, knows which page the visitor is on, matches their language on every message, and can be switched on or off remotely - no redeploy.

Streaming chat over SSE, page-context aware
Per-message language matching and configurable appearance
Remote on/off and roll-out without touching the host site

items.title: Knowledge From Your Catalogue
items.body: Crawls your site and walks your WooCommerce or Shopify catalogue, plus uploads and text. Hybrid vector-and-keyword search finds the right passage, with product and price extraction that respects EU Omnibus pricing.

items.title: Duties: Work in the Background
items.body: Beyond the chat, the agent runs scheduled duties for the shop - catalogue audits, monitors, a weekly commerce analysis, even write-backs to your store - each one drafted for review before anything actually changes.

items.title: Hard to Trick
items.body: Untrusted web and catalogue content is sanitized and fenced, an input tripwire catches injection attempts, and an output scanner stops leaks mid-stream. It won't be talked into going off-script.

items.title: Built On
items.body: Next.js 16 and React 19 on the front end; FastAPI with async SQLAlchemy on the backend and agent runtime; Celery and Redis for crawls and scheduled duties; PostgreSQL 17 with pgvector for storage and hybrid search - all in Docker, bilingual in Croatian and English. The interesting engineering isn't the model; it's everything that keeps the model honest.

closing.title: Meet Your Webshop's AI Employee
closing.body: Moj Kolega is live and taking on shops now. See it answer real questions in your language, then get one set up for your own catalogue.

hr.title: Moj Kolega
hr.subtitle: AI zaposlenik za Vaš webshop. Odgovara kupcima, preporučuje iz Vašeg kataloga, hvata upite koje biste izvan radnog vremena izgubili i prosljeđuje ih Vašem timu kad treba — 24/7. Mi ga postavljamo, nadziremo i svaki mjesec poboljšavamo. Vi vidite rezultate, a ne još jedan chatbot.

sections.title: Zaposlite ulogu, a ne chatbot
sections.lede: Većina trgovina prikvači chatbot, gleda kako pogađa krivo i ugasi ga. Moj Kolega je suprotno: vođeni AI zaposlenik koji odgovara isključivo iz Vašeg kataloga i pravila, kaže „ne znam" umjesto da izmišlja i svaki je mjesec bolji jer ga netko doista prati.

items.title: Utemeljeno, nikad izmišljeno
items.body:
Odgovara samo iz Vašeg kataloga i pravila
Kad podatka nema, to i kaže te proslijedi dalje — ne pogađa
Uz svaki predloženi proizvod ide razlog za kupnju, isključivo iz Vašeg kataloga
Svaki se odgovor može pratiti do izvora iz kojeg je došao

items.title: Vođeno, ne uradi-sam
items.body:
Ne dobivate uređivač promptova i izbornik modela. Zapošljavate ulogu — prodaja, podrška ili recepcija — a mi radimo ostalo: postavimo ga, povežemo Vaš katalog i testiramo ga na stvarnim pitanjima prije nego što ide u rad.

Zatim svaki mjesec šaljemo izvještaj o tome što su Vaši kupci pitali, što je agent riješio sam, što je promašio i što smo promijenili. Proizvod je upravo to poboljšanje, a ne nadzorna ploča koju morate stalno nadgledati.

sections.title: Pet poslova koje odrađuje pouzdano
sections.lede: Ne četrdeset poslova koje generički model odradi loše. Pet onih koji su webshopu doista važni, svaki utemeljen na Vašim podacima.

items.title: Odgovara iz Vaših podataka
items.body: Iz Vašeg kataloga i pravila. Kad ne zna, to kaže i preda dalje — nikad ne pogađa i ne košta Vas prodaje.

items.title: Preporučuje pravi proizvod
items.body: Dva ili tri prijedloga za potrebu i proračun, svaki s razlogom za kupnju — izvučeni iz Vašeg kataloga, nikad izmišljeni.

items.title: Hvata upite koje biste izgubili
items.body: Veleprodaja, B2B i neodlučni kupci — kvalificirani, s cijelim razgovorom, na Vašem stolu ujutro umjesto da nestanu do zore.

items.title: Sigurno prosljeđuje dalje
items.body: Kad mu je preko glave, predaje Vašem timu s punim kontekstom — čista predaja, a ne blef.

items.title: Govori jezikom Vaših kupaca
items.body: Na svakoj poruci prepoznaje jezik posjetitelja i odgovara na njemu — hrvatski, engleski, slovenski, srpski i njemački.

items.title: Radi noćnu smjenu
items.body: Upiti izmiču upravo u satima kad Vaš tim nije tu. Moj Kolega ih pokriva — i ujutro Vam preda noćne razgovore.

sections.title: Jedna skripta koja poznaje Vašu trgovinu
sections.lede: Moj Kolega se na bilo koju stranicu spušta kao jedan widget — ali pouzdanim ga čini posao iza njega.

items.title: Ugradivi widget
items.body:
Jedan script tag na bilo kojoj stranici. Odgovore prenosi token po token, zna na kojoj je stranici posjetitelj, na svakoj poruci prati njegov jezik i može se uključiti ili isključiti na daljinu — bez novog deploya.

Streaming chata preko SSE-a, svjestan konteksta stranice
Prilagodba jezika po poruci i podesiv izgled
Uključivanje, isključivanje i uvođenje na daljinu, bez diranja stranice domaćina

items.title: Znanje iz Vašeg kataloga
items.body: Obilazi Vašu stranicu i prolazi kroz WooCommerce ili Shopify katalog, uz priložene datoteke i tekst. Hibridna vektorska i tekstualna pretraga pronalazi pravi odlomak, uz izvlačenje proizvoda i cijena, usklađeno s EU Omnibus pravilima o cijenama.

items.title: Zadaci: rad u pozadini
items.body: Osim chata, agent za trgovinu obavlja i zakazane zadatke — provjere kataloga, nadzor, tjednu analizu prodaje, čak i upisivanje natrag u Vašu trgovinu — svaki od njih prvo kao prijedlog na pregled, prije nego što se išta stvarno promijeni.

items.title: Teško ga je prevariti
items.body: Nepouzdan sadržaj s weba i iz kataloga čisti se i ograđuje, okidač na ulazu hvata pokušaje ubacivanja uputa, a skener na izlazu zaustavlja curenje usred odgovora. Neće ga se nagovoriti da izađe iz uloge.

items.title: Izgrađeno na
items.body: Next.js 16 i React 19 na frontendu; FastAPI s asinkronim SQLAlchemyjem na backendu i u pogonu agenta; Celery i Redis za obilaske i zakazane zadatke; PostgreSQL 17 s pgvectorom za pohranu i hibridnu pretragu — sve u Dockeru, dvojezično na hrvatskom i engleskom. Zanimljivo inženjerstvo nije model, nego sve ono što model drži poštenim.

closing.title: Upoznajte AI zaposlenika svog webshopa
closing.body: Moj Kolega je u pogonu i prima nove trgovine. Pogledajte kako odgovara na stvarna pitanja na Vašem jeziku, pa ga postavimo i za Vaš katalog.
